sources.title: Completely positive factorization by a Riemannian smoothing method

inspection.scope: Extracted article text read, including definitions, convergence theorems, numerical sections and conclusion. Figure-only plotting labels are not mathematical dependencies.
inspection.locators: Definitions (3)-(4), printed p.936; Theorem 2.2, p.937; Theorem 3.6, pp.947-948; boundary numerical examples, p.954; limitations, p.963.
